title: These will Leak Air
text: These will Leak Air. Worked great until we went into the closet to find that they leaked and we struggled mightily to get them out of the closet because they had returned to almost original height and thickness.

product_metadata.title: Vacwel 14-Pack Variety - Ziplock Vacuum Storage Bags for Clothes - Space Saver Bags for Packing Clothes - Vacuum Space Bags – 4xJumbo (43x30in) +4xLarge (32x21in) +6xMedium (28x20in) +Bonus Hand Pump
features: WHAT'S INCLUDED: 14-Pack Variety - 4x Jumbo (43x30in) + 4x Large (32x21in) +6x Medium (28x20in) + Bonus Hand Pump. Transparent space bags – See at a glance the contents of these heavy duty vacuum storage bags without having to open them. The transparent parts of the bags allow you to easily identify and access the items stored, making it more convenient and faster to find the items you are looking for.

MAXIMIZE YOUR STORAGE SPACE with our vacuum bags! Available in jumbo, large and medium sizes, they're perfect for packing away seasonal clothes, blankets, pillows, linens, cushions, duvets, and bedding sets. Say goodbye to cluttered closets and hello to a tidy home with our convenient storage solution.

EASY TO USE: With Vacwel's vacuum storage bags, you don't have to worry about your items getting damaged by dust or dampness. These ziplock bags vacuum compress using any standard vacuum cleaner nozzle, and once vacuumed, the compressed plastic bag will lock air out and prevent dust or dampness infiltration. Plus, with the double seal and airtight vacuum valve system, you can rest assured that your items will stay safe and secure, even during long-term storage.

QUALITY MADE AND DURABLE: Unlike other vacuum storage bags on the market that tear or lose their suction over time, Vacwel's bags are built to last. Made with an upgraded nylon lining for enhanced durability, these bags are thick yet flexible, striking the perfect balance between strength and flexibility. Plus, the unique colored caps and triple seal valves make it easy to find the bag size you want and ensure quality seal closures every time.

GOODWILL: Creating space with Vacwel also creates opportunities! Vacwel gives 5% of sale profits to Sub-Zero, a charity that provide the homeless and disaster-stricken victims of America with essential needs to survive the cold.
